subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “A city can speak many languages at once.”?
options: People need the power to keep it working.
People need commitment, not only clicks.
People only need to slow down and read it.
People need quiet spaces before the world enters.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「People need the power to keep it working.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「People need commitment, not only clicks.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「A city can speak many languages at once. People only need to slow down and read it.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「People need quiet spaces before the world enters.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「A city can speak many languages at once. People only need to slow down and read it.」，答案為「People only need to slow down and read it.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「People only need to slow down and read it.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
